summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures contract continued its fluctuating trend at lows today, with the most-tradedcontract I2605 closing at 740.5 yuan/mt, down 1.79% from the previous trading session. Spot prices fell 5-8 yuan/mt from the previous session. Traders showed limited enthusiasm in offering, while steel mills remained cautious and watchful.
